records.title: Residual MPC: Blending Reinforcement Learning with GPU-Parallelized Model Predictive Control
records.publication_update: Author publication page now lists IEEE Transactions on Robotics, 2026; DOI 10.1109/TRO.2026.3721669. Existing arXiv paper downloaded is v1, 2025-10-14; this is not counted as a new paper.
records.read_scope: Verified author publication metadata and abstract, downloaded v1, inspected selected GPU implementation and torque-residual architecture passages; not a full read of the journal revision.
records.use_boundary: Torque-level residual authority and a GPU-parallel kinodynamic MPC are architectural changes; this paper does not establish that more cap-only training will repair current fast contact failures. No automatic controller replacement is planned.

records.title: Impact-Aware Robust Convex MPC for Quadruped Locomotion on Uncertain Terrain
records.publication: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters11(7),7820-7827,2026; publication date2026-05-11

read: official IEEE indexed abstract and metadata
read_scope.access_limit: IEEE page required JavaScript/anti-bot response; author full text not obtained; ResearchGate only offered request-full-text.

records.mechanism_from_abstract: Bounded impact momentum disturbance in an SRB model, min-max optimization transformed into a QP with a relaxation mechanism.
records.recommended_use: May support the distinction between touchdown disturbance robustness and a smooth impact penalty, but already TM32 and not a newly discovered paper.
limitations: Abstract-only; cannot infer exact feasible set, bounds, implementation or guarantees.
do_not_claim: Do not count as a new source beyondTM01-34.

records.title: Planning to Learn: Real-Time Robust Adaptive Control on the GPU with Guaranteed Future Learning
records.read_scope: Downloaded complete v1 PDF; read problem formulation and SLS preliminaries (section III), estimator and uncertainty update (IV A-B), selected reachability/constraint derivations (IV C-E), quadruped and Crazyflie experiments and conclusion. Appendix proofs not read in full. Author project methods and official repository README read; implementation not audited or reproduced.
records.mechanism: Augment the physical state with parameter estimates. Propagate correlated disturbance, parameter error and estimate-update effects through SLS; forecast the bounded uncertainty remaining after future observations, rather than holding the initial uncertainty fixed over the horizon.
records.author_reported_evidence: Equations 12-15 update the estimate and zonotope generators; quadruped experiment uses 61 states, 12 inputs and 8 unknown joint-damping parameters, with parameter observations gated to swing. Section V reports 38/40 stable runs, versus 24/40 for non-adaptive SLS, and median solve time 16.1 ms under a 32 ms budget. These are author results on that model, not this repository.
records.project_use: A close long-term analogue for putting evolving terrain knowledge inside candidate prediction: current loading changes both future material state and what can be inferred. Current frozen PANN observations plus scalar cap do not yet implement this coupling.
limits: The demonstration learns joint damping, not a recovering, spatially persistent terrain constitutive state.
The formulation requires a meaningful bounded parameter/disturbance model and estimator dynamics; the current PANN has no calibrated uncertainty tube.
A GPU-compatible SLS solver is a different implementation from the CPU MuJoCo iLQG backend. No transferable speed or safety guarantee is claimed.
Not a precondition or proposed wholesale replacement for W39.

records.title: Shooting for Contact: Contact-Implicit Multiple Shooting for Dynamic Motion Retargeting
records.read_scope: Downloaded full v2 PDF; read sections II-III dynamics, differentiable simulator, multiple-shooting formulation, cost and receding-horizon control, selected gait-library and hardware/result passages. Read author project methods and limitation-relevant distinctions. Not a full source-code audit or reproduction.
records.mechanism: Optimize shooting-node states and command control points; enforce continuity with the simulator's integrated transition map. Fine contact substeps are chained between coarser shooting nodes. Constraints and costs include whole-body dynamics, actuation, state/body tracking, realized torque and command increments.
records.author_reported_evidence: Equations 5a-d define the constrained NLP; equations 10-12 distinguish realized-torque cost from raw position-command cost and add command-rate regularization. A PD command is not itself a torque. Author references are dynamically feasible in the chosen simulator, and policies are trained against these references.
records.project_use: Inspect the actual accepted trajectory and executed command/support chain, not only a kinematic reference or reduced objective. A future input-bandwidth change belongs inside prediction and optimization with the same actuator interface.
limits: MuJoCo simulator feasibility does not establish true TM02 material feasibility.
Its main result is offline or receding-window motion retargeting and imitation RL, not the current online PANN-PPO-cap-iLQG architecture.
Do not replace the whole solver or add output low-pass filtering under this citation in W39.
No evidence from this paper identifies the unique cause of the r27 failures.

records.title: Accelerating and Scaling MPC-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation
records.read_scope: Downloaded full v1 PDF; read sections II-IV formulation, prediction-landmark rewards, parallel-in-horizon solver and training/PD interface, and relevant section V solver and locomotion comparisons. Did not reproduce experiments or audit the full solver implementation.
records.mechanism: The pi^n MPC solver exposes both environment and horizon dimensions to batched GPU ADMM, using time-varying dynamics directly rather than assembling a large QP or keeping serial Riccati recursion. Centroidal MPC trajectories guide training rewards; deployment uses a learned low-level policy.
records.author_reported_evidence: Equations 18-22 lift the previous input and split the optimization into local horizon-parallel updates. Training uses 4096 environments, 200 Hz physics and a 50 Hz joint-position policy. Prediction landmarks compare predictions with the realized state at their matching timestamp. Reported default MPC guidance is N=10 at 10 Hz; increasing rate did not improve every metric.
records.project_use: Explains what real GPU scaling requires: a batch-compatible solver and environment, not simply more VRAM or setting a Torch device. The current 88% CPU-planning share motivates a later, explicitly budgeted backend project.
limits: Centroidal contact-wrench MPC and training-only guidance differ from full-body iLQG in the execution loop.
The author's humanoid policy has 29 joint-position actions; it is not the current 2 Hz scalar cap.
MuJoCo/TM02 0.2 ms material dynamics, persistent cell history, original contact/torque thresholds and evaluation semantics must remain equivalent in any later backend migration.
Do not copy Themis-specific 1-2 Hz gain choices to Go2, or claim a CUDA switch provides the paper's throughput.

records.title: Dexterous Contact-Rich Manipulation via the Contact Trust Region
records.publication: 2025 preprint, latest arXiv v4 2025-11-03; IJRR volume 45 issue 9 (2026)

not_read: source code; project page says code coming soon
read_scope.figures: captions/text read; not a pixel-by-pixel inspection

mechanisms.detail: Joint local affine models of next configuration q+ and average contact force lambda; lambda is force and h*lambda is impulse.

Full CTR intersects an ellipsoidal perturbation region with the local dynamics, primal contact-velocity feasibility, and dual friction-cone feasibility; it is a convex SOCP local model, not a guarantee for true nonlinear dynamics.
Actual optimization uses relaxed R-CTR, dropping primal feasibility to avoid overconservatism while retaining dual contact-force cone feasibility. Action-only form fixes delta_q=0.
A constrained SOCP local optimization replaces an iLQR-style Bellman step; nominal trajectory is rolled out with unsmoothed dynamics, local model is built from smoothed dynamics.
Joint/actuation bounds are steady-state approximations; authors explicitly exclude dynamic transient torque.

records.relevance: A local feedback/optimization correction must respect unilateral contact and actuator authority. A smooth gradient or isotropic small correction alone does not define a physically useful domain.
limitations: Model is quasi-dynamic, configuration-only, highly damped, not full floating-base Go2 dynamics.
Anitescu contact relaxation introduces hydroplaning; barrier smoothing produces force at a distance.
The actual R-CTR does not enforce full primal contact feasibility.
Second-order deployment uses 1-2 second action chunks and contact-reestablishment initialization; do not copy this to dynamic locomotion.
Section9.2 explicitly reports unresolved occasional contact loss in second-order simulation/hardware and says legged use may need balance constraints.
No proof that this solves the repository r27 failures; no material-memory validation.
records.recommended_use: Use as rationale to examine the local domain of planned/feedback corrections; any MuJoCo dynamic-state, PD and contact feasibility mapping must be derived for this repository.
do_not_claim: Do not call posthoc K clipping a CTR implementation.
Do not add another force residual using unvalidated MakeDifferentiable forces and call it force feasibility.
Do not call the controller robust or torque-safe merely because a local cone or steady-state torque bound exists.
records.version_caution: Downloaded RAI PDF MotionSets_TRO2024-1.pdf is an older draft with different FTR/CTR naming. Canonical equation references above use arXiv v4 HTML, not that draft.

records.title: Robustifying Model-Based Locomotion by Zero-order Stochastic Nonlinear Model Predictive Control with Guard Saltation Matrix

read_in_full: main text sections I-VI, including formulation, saltation/guard covariance, approximation, simulation, hardware and conclusion
read_scope.figures: text/captions read; no pixel-by-pixel plot extraction

mechanisms.detail: Closed-loop covariance propagation on smooth segments.
Propagates uncertainty from contact guard height/timing separately from state perturbations.
Uses an EKF-like covariance update at observed contact events to reduce excessive covariance growth.
Covariance produces constraint backoff; sensitivity of covariance/backoff is omitted in the optimization step, using warm-started gains to reduce runtime cost.

records.relevance: A landing perturbation changes when contact happens and therefore the post-contact state. Smooth state Jacobians and isotropic process noise alone do not explicitly capture that effect.
limitations: Prescribed mode sequence and switching times, not unconstrained new-contact discovery.
Requires a well-defined guard, reset map, and transverse crossing; direct formula is unsuitable at grazing singularities.
Multiple-foot extension is explicitly heuristic; no general simultaneous-contact guarantee.
Dynamics use a full centroidal model; experiments are a wheeled telescopic-leg robot and a simulated humanoid, not Go2 soft-terrain whole-body control.
Authors tune process covariance for conditioning, clip large backoffs and soften some state constraints.
Swing-foot collisions remain a failure mode; emergency replanning is unresolved.
records.recommended_use: If existing r27 event traces show predicted/actual touchdown timing or contact mode mismatch, use the hybrid transition structure to guide a mode-consistent local model; do not graft a saltation matrix onto already integrated compliant MuJoCo dynamics without deriving the event model.
do_not_claim: No unconditional stability guarantee on this repository.
No evidence that r27 feedback failed from a saltation defect before examining existing event traces.
Do not copy the printed backoff inequality sign without reconciling the repository constraint convention.

records.title: Fast Contact-Implicit Model-Predictive Control
records.publication: IEEE Transactions on Robotics40 (2024),1617-1629; first preprint2021, latest arXivv3 2023-01-06

read_scope.manuscript: Downloaded author-lab PDF, not asserted byte-identical to publisher final version.
read_in_full: sections III-IV (contact dynamics, interior-point differentiation, fast LCP, controller, height heuristic)
sections V-VI (simulation, Go1 execution, limitations and future work)
read_scope.code: Official GitHub repository landing page verified, not an implementation audit.
read_scope.figures: captions/tables read; not video or full pixel inspection

mechanisms.detail: Reference-dependent mass/Jacobian/contact-geometry approximations retain a nonlinear complementarity structure in a time-varying LCP. The local controller can change contact timing and modes without integer optimization.

Differentiate an interior-point solution with finite central-path parameter; near-hard subgradients omit nearby mode information. Online planning commonly uses kappa approximately1e-4; nonlinear verification uses approximately1e-6.

Upper-level trajectory optimization uses lower-level LCP dynamics; a contact-height estimate updates signed distance after measured contact. Short horizons, warm starts, fixed iterations and prefactorization limit runtime.

Go1 hardware uses a simplified 36-state point-foot model with force controls and no leg dynamics; a pretuned1000Hz torque controller realizes desired foot forces. MPC is approximately100Hz with0.10-0.15s horizons.

records.relevance: Contact switching structure can be preserved even with useful smoothing. However, the executed low-level force controller and a realizable reference remain essential parts of reported behavior.
limitations: Substantial backend/contact-solver replacement relative to the current MuJoCo whole-body iLQG, not a short drop-in patch.
Reference trajectories must already be good; offline contact-implicit generation is explicitly unreliable.
The authors explicitly report conventional convexMPC is more robust for general locomotion because it additionally has online Raibert foothold selection.
No deformable-memory model or Go2 terrain success proof.
Do not advertise2024 publication as an algorithm first proposed in2024 or2026.
records.recommended_use: Use the authors own limitations to avoid treating smooth derivatives or free contact switching as sufficient. The repository must connect plausible references, contact response and low-level execution.
do_not_claim: Do not map the paper force-input Go1 results directly to our joint-position+PD execution.
Do not infer a guaranteed speedup from a different LCP implementation.

records.title: Convergent iLQR for Safe Trajectory Planning and Control of Legged Robots

read_in_full: main text sections I-VI in arXivv3 HTML, including equations, algorithm, examples and limitations
read_scope.figures: captions and data tables read; not pixel-by-pixel plot inspection

mechanisms.detail: Measures worst-case local initial-to-final error growth, including hybrid event saltation.
Two backward passes separate the tracking gains used to evaluate convergence from the search gains used to find a better trajectory. A line search accepts a lower convergence-augmented cost.
Derivatives of the maximum singular value involve derivatives of the closed-loop state maps and saltation; implementation uses finite differences and BFGS.

records.relevance: Even equal tracking gains can behave very differently on different nominal trajectories. A lower nominal objective is not evidence that the trajectory can be tracked with the available local feedback authority.
limitations: MATLAB simulations of a rocket hopper and a planar spring-legged quadruped only; hardware is future work.
The four-dimensional derivative tensor needed for exact Hessians is expensive; authors describe current algorithm as useful for offline planning, not established real-time full-body control.
Quadruped convergence measure improves60.52 to41.35, remaining greater than1; improved robustness is not universal contraction.
Linear analysis assumes nearby trajectories undergo the same mode transition.
Not a hard actuator feasibility or contact-force guarantee.
records.recommended_use: Supports keeping accepted trajectory, feedback reference and actual tracking performance distinct; do not add chi cost or a new convergence qualification matrix to the immediate r28 on this evidence.
do_not_claim: Do not confuse the optimization search gains with the deployed tracking gains.

records.title: Terramechanics-Aware Adaptive Quadrupedal Locomotion via Foot-Terrain Interaction Model
records.publication: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters11(11),12552-12559,2026; publication date2026-09-10

read: official IEEE indexed abstract and bibliographic metadata
not_read: full text, equations, implementation, complete experimental protocol
read_scope.access_limit: Official full page returned418; no author full text found in focused title/DOI searches. No access workaround attempted.

records.mechanism_from_abstract: VirtualGround introduces plastic-yield-inspired nonlinear foot-terrain forces, including sinkage, shear saturation and declining bearing capacity. A gait adaptation component estimates friction/deformability from contact history and adjusts gait features.
records.reported_evidence_from_abstract: IsaacSim and MPM Newton Physics simulations plus Go2 experiments on sand/tile/beach; details not independently read.
records.relevance: Contact history can inform a control variable with gait authority, rather than only a risk score. Plastic deformation and recoverable viscoelastic material memory must be kept distinct.
limitations: Cannot report equations, reproduction parameters or measured success from unseen full text.
The current PANN2Hz scalarcap has different action authority from gait adaptation.
Do not change ground-truth material solely to make the controller succeed.
records.recommended_use: New relevant terrain-neighbor lead with explicit abstract-only status; not execution prerequisite or sole basis for r28.
do_not_claim: Not proof that this repository material model or control architecture succeeds.

records.title: Adaptive Legged Locomotion via Online Learning for MPC

read: method outline describing random-Fourier-feature residual model and online gradient update
not_read: complete theory/proofs, all method equations, full experiments, source code
read_scope.downloaded: FullPDF and text saved; download does not equal full reading.

records.mechanism_from_read_sections: Learn an additive dynamics residual with random Fourier features and online supervised gradient updates, then insert the current model into MPC; authors state dynamic regret bounds under assumptions.
records.relevance: A separate modeling correction route if executed-transition error dominates; not a remedy for feedback/PD authority loss and not a replacement for already causal PANN memory.
limitations: Current reading is insufficient to recommend an implementation.
Reported validation is simulation rather than verified Go2 material traversal.
Do not cite stated regret guarantee without checking all assumptions.
records.recommended_use: Preserve as a partially read candidate, not one of the four core new full-method readings and not an execution gate.

cross_paper_synthesis.supported: Useful contact gradients, executable references, unilateral force consistency and actuator authority are distinct requirements. Smooth costs alone do not establish the others.
cross_paper_synthesis.r27_known: Per current_joint/root read-only analysis: C2 gate/accounting is wired; twoE30 runs still fail at trunk contact. All joints having ever saturated is insufficient to diagnose a particular feedback spike.
cross_paper_synthesis.r27_unknown: Accepted-rollout/feedback/reference/time-resolvedKdelta diagnostics remain server-only. Literature cannot determine whether nominal plan, local correction, or low-level execution first becomes invalid.
cross_paper_synthesis.practical_advice: Use the already generated twoE30 event windows to separate nominal plan from feedback-updated command and actually clipped/applied torque. Then choose one directly supported repair inside the existing whole-body+TVfeedback+PD backbone. Do not add arbitrary gains, force residuals or another large qualification suite.
cross_paper_synthesis.transfer_boundary: No paper reviewed here validates this Go2 recoverable-material PANN setup or dictates one proven r28 patch.

colleague_verified_actuator_facts.source: current_joint研究代理于2026-11-05的只读源码核对；research_history未独立重复该源码审计。
facts: Plant and MPC use the sameXML kp60/kd5, joint qtarget ctrlrange and23.7/45.43Nm forcerange.
Candidate and TV execution both clip qtarget; mjd_transitionFD A/B includes the samePD and torque saturation.
Riccati boxQP explicitly bounds qtarget angle; torque saturation and contact modes remain implicit in dynamics, not an explicit state-dependent feedback feasibility set.
consequences: The claim that rollout omits torque limits is false.
An instantaneous projection to the unsaturatedPD target interval, if nonempty, would produce the same current torque as existing forcerange clipping; it is not an established impact reduction fix.

conditional_implementation_advice.existing_evidence_first: Use already produced E30 event traces, without a new benchmark or training admission gate, to distinguish unsafe accepted nominal rollout from damage introduced after feedback.
conditional_implementation_advice.if_accepted_rollout_already_contains_ter: Consider lexicographic physical-feasibility-first candidate acceptance, using the same terminal trunk/nonfoot geometry and native forward substeps before objective ranking. ExistingTrunkClearance gradient/risk may provide search direction; do not reintroduce a contact force target. This is a project-specific engineering inference, not a CTR or saltation reproduction.
conditional_implementation_advice.infeasible_case: If all candidates remain physically infeasible, report restoration/infeasibility rather than claiming safety. Do not turn the rule into another count-based external qualification gate.
conditional_implementation_advice.if_only_feedback_updated_execution_becom: First locate the exact contact/actuator regime and reference consistency that is violated. The reviewed literature supports considering local contact-executable correction, but does not prescribe a proven small r28 patch for thisMuJoCo dynamic pipeline.
do_not_preset: No claim that another instantaneous torque projection repairs missing limits.
No addedchi cost, saltation covariance layer,SOCP orWBC replacement before evidence supports that scope.

reading_and_transfer_boundaries: 各原文URL、版本与实际读取范围逐条保存；读者身份区分root与research_history，合并不意味着另一代理重复全文阅读。
原始PDF/HTML、完整原文、下载哈希清单及临时工具引用ID不进入此紧凑交付。
论文报告的实验、吞吐、约束或保证均属于作者模型与实验条件，不等于本项目Go2材料穿越已成功。
当前2Hz标量cap不等于足端、步态、关节或扭矩残差权限；GPU显存不能直接改变CPU C++ iLQG的算法结构。
从已有r27两E30事件段区分accepted nominal自身问题与feedback之后的问题，是项目证据判断；不能从论文直接推出唯一r28根因或修复。
本复核不预设任意K裁剪、全局去平滑、新力残差、输出低通、saltation/chi代价或完整SOCP/WBC后端替换；实际修订范围由最新主计划与已有事件证据决定。
